fusions.name: Anchor Thread
fusions.desc: Shoots a thread into the first enemy it meets, dealing 10 damage, making it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and pinning it for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Silk Bite
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A bite that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Spun Snare
fusions.desc: Spins a snare onto the nearest enemy. It waits 60 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles set off a blast that deals 20 damage.

fusions.name: Silk Ledger
fusions.desc: Every hit you land ties a strand to that enemy, up to 4. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: the strands pull tight and strike it for part of your weapon damage per strand. Unfed, a strand fades every 4 seconds.
